title: School Credit for a Snowsports School Session Lost to the Mountain
content:
Where the collective cannot run a Snowsports School session because the mountain is shut, the lifts the session depends on are held, or conditions on the hill make the session unsafe, the school makes that session good as school credit on the booking it was lost from. The credit sits against the booking, where the household can see it and spend it on school charges.

## The write the desk makes

The desk records the make-good by putting school credit on the booking. The tool for that write is `issue_weather_session_credit_1ce20aea`, which the collective keeps out of the everyday tool list: the agent unlocks it and then calls it. It writes a single credit entry on that booking's school account carrying the amount handed back and the note that it answers for a session lost to the mountain, and raises the school credit standing on the booking record by the same amount.

## Parameters of the call

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `lesson_id` | Id class — the reference number of the snowsports school booking whose account the credit is put on, read from the school booking lookup for the household account. |
| `credit_amount_usd` | Fixed-format class — the amount of school credit handed back, expressed in USD as a positive number carried to 2 decimal places and rounded half up at the cent; it is stored exactly as passed and an empty value is not accepted. |

Neither parameter is a condition on the household: `lesson_id` identifies the booking the entry belongs to, and `credit_amount_usd` is the figure the agent has already worked out.

## What comes back

A confirmation sentence carrying the reference number minted for the new school credit entry, the booking reference the entry sits on, the credited amount in USD to two decimal places, and the school credit total now standing on that booking in USD to two decimal places. The presence of that sentence is what indicates the credit entry was written.

## Basis questions on the call

**What does the household see once the entry is written?** The credit entry on the booking's school account, and a higher school credit standing on the booking record itself.

**Does the call decide whether the make-good is due?** No. The tool performs the write with the figure it is given; whether a session was lost to the mountain, and what the make-good comes to, are settled on the Snowsports School terms before the call is made.
